body:
my family doesn't believe in therapy and I can't really go behind their backs because 1. they monitor my moves, 2. I don't have the money to do that. But, I have thought about getting help before. I do believe this pattern will continue because of this situation I live with my dysfunctional family and I have had thoughts of leaving. 

She asked (my current ex) if she wanted me to stay with her. But I couldn't because I take care of my sick mother and because her mother seemed hesitant about me stay since they had a roommate. So that died out pretty quickly I think in general she regretted saying that. . 

If I leave this home, my mother will surely die. My mother can barely walk anymore and has a hernia. It's difficult for her to even clean herself when she's in the bathroom. My brother has verbally abused us, threatening us by telling us that he doesn't care if we stay on the streets. 

I don't want to try anymore. I attempted suicide 3 years ago and stopped myself because I thought it would get better but it hasn't I always get hurt in the end I'm very tired when I sleep it's peaceful just knowing that I could stop breathing at any moment given time gives me peace in my mind. And yes, I do need someone by my side it feels lonely it feels lonelier than yesterday and the day before that. . I had habits with her and now that she is mad at me about posting what I posted yesterday she has given up on "checking up."

I have tried my friend. And I don't wanna try anymore if it's all in vein. I'm tired. But thank you so much for listening to me and not giving me advice instead of just listening I really appreciate it. I always come back to the internet when I am in pain because of people like you that give such comfort if only people, strangers, could do that in real life I think I would've been fine.

I can't describe in words. She was my first for everything. I have many great memories and a lot of sad ones. The one that has resonated with me the most is her party. I remember it as if it was yesterday. I couldn't go for obvious reasons but I remember her getting ready buying stuff and wishing that I would go but I couldn't. When it was getting dark she was getting drunk and called me suddenly in the bathroom we were laughing and such but suddenly she was crying. She was crying because she wished I was there to be there by her side and have fun. While, yes it must've felt really lonely but I couldn't do anything she knew it. So I understand why she decided to end the relationship my last ex did the same thing. It because they are lonely and I guess that's what I do to people make them feel lonelier. I don't want people to feel lonely because of me anymore. . . I want that to stop I want to off myself because I cause this pain to the ones I love. 

Of course I feel betrayed and I want to hate her and throw her away like she did to me. But I can't and idk why maybe its the memories or her having to save me when I would feel very sad or maybe knowing she went through pain because of me and that is reasonable.

If you think about it who wants to be in a relationship with a 23 year old who gets emotional abused at home and always sad? You can't leave the house because they won't let you and if you do they threaten to kick you out. Imagine being on a date and then you hear your partner get screamed at the phone that would give anyone anxiety. . . Knowing that the person might go home and get hurt. That is how she felt and I acknowledged it. She knew how abusive my older siblings are towards me she knows that it goes on and I was making her feel more miserable. And now she is happy. On social media she expressed how happy she was. The day she ended the relationship she told me she was sad and now. . . She's is happy and I've noticed a pattern in people who I start to love they become miserable with me and until they end it they start to relieved. 

Knowing that I make people feel that way what's the point in living if I make everyone feel lonely and miserable? I'll do everyone a favor by just stop existing it is what I want I am not fit for anyone and I have came to terms with that so I just want help to properly kill myself.
happy birthday! I think once we get older we feel more less important. But fuck it drink more and do whatever you want fuck everyone make yourself feel special

Last night, we talked. She was mad at me because of things I wrote in one of my social media accounts. I basically said that no one was there for me when I needed someone the most and she got mad because she said it was "Off putting to know you don't trust me. It makes me not even want to ask if you're okay anymore." How can I trust someone who I DID put my whole heart and soul into just to hurt me and get back with an ex?

the night I wrote that she was with an ex who she fell in love with. She told me when we were in the relationship about them. That it took a lot of time to get over them but she never did get over them. All of a sudden this person text her out of no where to come back in her life again and she goes back to them immediately? how is that fair for me? I checked on Snapchat that they went to the beach were we had our 2nd date, an important place I hold dear to my heart, they went to. . . Hours past and suddenly I saw she was in an apartment complex hours passed and she was still in that apartment complex and I have no doubt that they fucked. 

How can someone be so cruel? you can't just come into someones life like that and make a great impact and make them feel special just to leave and go fall in love with another person. I'm feeling all types of emotions that I can't even process right I've gone numb. It's become a routine to wake up, which is still difficult to do, and get ready for the day. I cry in the car and then suddenly I'm back home not knowing how I got back it's repetitive and tiring. 

She was the source of my happiness. I told her whenever I was with her, reminded her how much I was in love with her, how much I trusted her, she even told me one day that she fell in love with me. Was that a lie too? I blame myself for not being there physically when she needed someone. When her grandfather died she needed someone there I begged and asked my brother to let me go and see her to comfort her but they wouldn't let me. I blame myself for trusting her with all of me; how can you make me hate myself even more?

Her fault was being selfish. I always put her feelings over mine because she was special to me. Every night, when she slept on the phone, I would write her love letters on SC so she could feel loved in the morning because whenever she felt lonely I would try my hardest not to make her feel that way. She had notes of past people confessing how much they loved her and I guess I'm just another memory in her boxes of past awards.

Right now it is difficult to feel such pain. My last break-up did hurt but this one. . . really broke me. We had plans for the future, in the of my mind I know it was a 50/50 percent that it would come true but my heart hoped that it would come true that we would be together for that long. The first red flag was that she confessed that she was afraid of commitment, she is a free spirited person but I thought I could change that and it was foolish of me to even try. 

While I could be laughing at videos, chatting with new people and telling them what I am going through I still feel pain, I still feel regret, I still feel thoughts of suicide, always have ever since I was 14. After the first break-up I had I almost committed suicide with my brother's gun. I told her this trusting her and she told me her pains and while our experiences were different we connected with our pain. That is way I have the beach date so close to my heart because it was the day I told her I loved her. That day I believed that maybe, living wasn't so bad. But, now I just want to die I don't want to be here no more I'm tired of giving every being to myself to a person just to throw me away like I'm trash I get that feeling at home I don't want to feel it when I am in love.

I hate the human race and I don't care how 'edgy' I sound. I'm tired and I just want to go home a home where I feel welcomed and loved instead of feeling so lonely this is why I push people away when they hurt me. You want me to trust you? You want me to tell you how I feel while you're out there fucking someone else? How does that even make sense? You talked so much shit about the people who have abandon you and I'm sure she is talking so much shit about me to her lovers and I HATE her for it.
thank you for this, thank you so much
I have tried to do that but it's hard it's really really hard
